items.title: Benny Powell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 16, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: so we formed this trio, Jane Jarvis, Earl May and myself. And we played at Zinno’s

ctx.x: Bill Berry’s there also. So it’s funny how everything comes full circle. Anyway we ate and we found out we enjoyed each other’s company. I found her utterly delightful and the things she likes. So we kind of kept in touch. I’ve sort of had a crusade really, to get some acknowledgement or recognition for her, so we formed this trio, Jane Jarvis, Earl May and myself. And we played at Zinno’s and when I go down to Ft. Lauderdale, I think when my little stage patter, I’ll say that when I was asked to join this band,…
So Earl May’s on the gig too, right?
